# Test 07: Dominance across type hierarchy
# A type pattern for Shape dominates a type pattern for Circle
# (since Circle is a subtype of Shape).
# Expected: exhaustive, case 1 (Circle) is dominated by case 0 (Shape)

TYPES
sealed Shape Circle Square
record Circle double:radius parent:Shape
record Square double:side parent:Shape

SWITCHES
switch s1 Shape
type Shape
type Circle
end
